name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of András Tivadar Kulja
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of András Tivadar Kulja, a Hungarian member of the European Parliament. A Hungarian court asked for this because a private party has brought a criminal case against him over a Facebook post from July 2025 about public money for medical equipment. The Parliament found that the post was not part of his duties as a member, and saw no sign that the case was meant to harm his political work.

- Kulja loses his immunity from prosecution in this defamation case in Hungary.
- It affects Kulja and the Hungarian court handling the private criminal case.
- The court can now continue the proceedings; the decision is sent to Hungary's authorities and to Kulja.
